notes.title: New Multiplayer System Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973971/ab7c7d7ffa3a45e86fe9d8569f2416b8af59b07e.png[/img]

[b]Hey Traceur![/b]

Our new multiplayer system is out now! You are able to easily join your friends via the Steam friends list and challenge them with your levels in real time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973971/442b764871981985319886c50c3cfbf1820739a6.gif[/img]

Furthermore, we added six more cubes to build levels with and some new mechanics for you to discover. As always, if you've got some creative ideas for new mechanics or functions, feel free sending them to us via the comments. There's a good chance that they get into the game.

We really want to thank all of our supporters. Have fun playing!
The Icegrim Team


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973971/be0be4247165d95fa8d546aa442b8ba75eed2a5e.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Multiplayer System Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973971/ab7c7d7ffa3a45e86fe9d8569f2416b8af59b07e.png[/img]

[b]Hey Traceur![/b]

Since the community is growing every day we wanted to let you know what we are currently working on and what you can expect in the coming updates.

As mentioned in the title, the biggest change will be our new multiplayer system. You will be able to easily join your friends via the Steam friends list and challenge them with your levels in real time.

Furthermore, we are going to add more and more cubes to build levels with. If you've got some creative ideas for new mechanics or functions, feel free sending them to us via the comments. There's a good chance that they get into the game.

We really want to thank all of our supporters. Have fun playing!
The Icegrim Team
